name: Asked when a person should be asked
purpose: Consent is kept for each person: for a risk signal or a stopped flow the decision is to ask when a person should authorize and to proceed otherwise, and a step that needs the person never proceeds without that decision.
record: Seventy-two cases (evaluation/judgment_calls/build_cases.py): the labelled run digests of the Nervous System's case sets (a step a person should authorize is high, an ordinary step is none), four flows stopped for budget or authority, and eight written cases that give each person their own limits. One number: the share of decisions that match. A replay of real decision requests would measure the per-person difference on real data; it is not in this set. Consent kept is what this number measures: a high-risk step that proceeds without asking fails its case outright and no other result can offset it, which is why consent is held here (Consciousness, alignment with the person's limits) and not in the Integrated Efficiency of The Self.
disadvantages: The per-person cases are written here, not replayed from real decision requests.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run judgment_calls --impl severity_policy; esoi run judgment_calls --impl ask_every_time
